### finance-functions.js

Excel finance and statistics functions that HyperFormula 2.7 lacks: IRR, XIRR,
VDB, INTERCEPT, FORECAST, PERCENTILE, QUARTILE, RANK, KURT, and the bond
functions PRICE, YIELD, DURATION, MDURATION, ACCRINT, ACCRINTM, the COUP*
functions, DISC, INTRATE, RECEIVED, PRICEDISC, PRICEMAT, YIELDDISC and YIELDMAT.
It also makes a bare `TRUE` and `FALSE` work.

Load it after Handsontable:

```html
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hyperformula@2.7.1/dist/hyperformula.full.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/handsontable@14.6.1/dist/handsontable.full.min.js"></script>
<script src="https://apps.kerryback.com/finance-functions.js"></script>
```

Then build the engine with the named expressions:

```js
const hf = HyperFormula.buildEmpty({ licenseKey: 'internal-use-in-handsontable' },
                                   FinanceFunctions.namedExpressions);
```

The comment at the top of the file has the details.
